build_VQModel: build a VQGAN model with an encoder, decoder, and vector quantizer for image reconstruction
encode_VQModel: encode an input image tensor through the VQModel encoder to get quantized latents and embedding loss
decode_VQModel: decode quantized latent vectors back to image space using the VQModel decoder
quantize_VectorQuantizer2: quantize continuous latent vectors to discrete codebook embeddings using VectorQuantizer2 forward pass
get_codebook_entry_VectorQuantizer2: retrieve quantized latent vectors from discrete codebook indices using VectorQuantizer2 get_codebook_entry
